hero.headline: You Don't Pay Until Your Roof Is Done!
hero.subheadline: A family-owned Wilkes-Barre roofing company, not a storm-chaser passing through. We quote it, we do it, we clean up after ourselves — and we don't take a dollar until the job is 100% complete and you're satisfied.

quote_card.quote: They completed the job in a day and a half, left no mess behind, and charged me exactly what he quoted.
quote_card.author: Sarah — Google Review

promise_band.headline: Pay When It's Done
promise_band.body: Plenty of roofers want a deposit before a single shingle comes off. We have never worked that way. You get a free estimate, we do the work, we clean up, and you look at it. If you are not satisfied, we are not finished. That has been the arrangement for over fifty years in the Wyoming Valley, and it is the reason most of our work comes from neighbors of people we have already worked for.

signature_system.headline: Roof Replacement Done Right
signature_system.intro: Every Gilroy job runs the same way, whether it is a full commercial rubber roof or a single storm repair. No surprises, no hidden fees, and no chasing us for answers.

blocks.title: We handle the insurance claim
blocks.body: Storm damage is the part homeowners dread most. We document the damage properly, deal with your adjuster, and keep the claim moving so you are not the one on the phone fighting for coverage.

blocks.title: 50-year material and labor warranty
blocks.body: As an Owens Corning Platinum Preferred Contractor we can back the work with a 50-year material and labor warranty — coverage most contractors in the area are not certified to offer.

signature_system.steps_title: Clean-up is part of the job, not an afterthought

steps.title: Debris straight to the dumpster
steps.body: Tear-off is cleared as we go, not left piled in your driveway.

steps.title: Magnet sweep for nails
steps.body: The whole yard and driveway, before we pack up.

steps.title: A final walk with you
steps.body: We check the property together before we leave.

guarantee.title: 100% satisfaction, or we're not finished
guarantee.body: No hidden fees, no surprises, and no invoice until you have looked at the work and told us you are happy with it. If something is not right, we come back and make it right.

steps.label: Step One
steps.title: Free inspection & estimate
steps.body: We come out, get on the roof, and put a written number in your hand.

steps.label: Step Two
steps.title: Installation or repair
steps.body: Most residential roofs are finished in a day to a day and a half.

steps.label: Step Three
steps.title: Full clean-up, then you pay
steps.body: Debris cleared, yard swept for nails, and no invoice until you're happy.

about_block.headline: Three Generations Of Roofers
about_block.body: Ed Gilroy Sr. started this business in 1972. His son Ed Jr. runs it today, and still shows up to do estimates himself. In fifty-four years we have served more than 10,000 customers across the Wyoming Valley, held an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau, and never asked anyone to pay before the work was finished.
checklist: A+ rated with the Better Business Bureau
Residential and commercial, insurance work welcome
Free estimates and all major credit cards accepted
about_block.photo_alt: A shingle-roofed family home of the kind we work on across the Wyoming Valley

seo_body.headline: Roof Replacement In Wilkes-Barre
paragraphs: Northeastern Pennsylvania is hard on roofs. Freeze-thaw works at flashing all winter, ice dams back water up under shingles, and summer storms take their turn at the rest.
We install asphalt and rubber systems specified for those conditions, backed by a 50-year material and labor warranty. Most residential replacements are done in a day to a day and a half.
checklist: Asphalt and rubber roofing, residential and commercial
Storm and leak repair with insurance claim handling
Gutter installation, repair, and attic venting
Most residential roofs completed in under two days

faqs.q: When do I have to pay?
faqs.a: Not until the project is 100% complete and you are satisfied with it. We do not take deposits up front. That has been our policy since 1972.

faqs.q: How can I tell if my roof needs replacing or just repairs?
faqs.a: An inspection is the only reliable way to know. We inspect free of charge, give you a detailed report of what we find, and quote both repair and replacement so you can decide with the facts in front of you.

faqs.q: Do you work with insurance claims?
faqs.a: Yes. Insurance work is routine for us. We document the damage to the standard adjusters expect and deal with your insurer directly so you are not the one chasing the claim.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with the work?
faqs.a: As an Owens Corning Platinum Preferred Contractor we back our roofing work with a 50-year material and labor warranty.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most residential roofs are completed in a day to a day and a half, depending on size and complexity. We tell you up front if we expect yours to take longer.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle both residential and commercial work, including flat and low-slope rubber roofing systems.
